hooks.command:
bash -c 'cd /Users/ab/P/TinyPhi/OpenWind; OUT=""; [ -f BLOCKERS.md ] && OUT="$OUT
=== BLOCKERS.md ===
$(cat BLOCKERS.md)"; [ -f PROGRESS.md ] && OUT="$OUT
=== PROGRESS.md (last 40 lines) ===
$(tail -40 PROGRESS.md)"; [ -n "$OUT" ] && echo -e "$OUT" || true'

bash -c 'CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".command // empty" 2>/dev/null || true); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(rm -rf|DROP TABLE|DROP DATABASE|--force-with-lease|git push --force|--no-verify|chmod 777)"; then echo "Blocked destructive command: $CMD" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null || true); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(\.env$|\.env\.|\.env\.local|secrets/)"; then echo "Protected file — refusing write to: $FILE" >&2; exit 2; fi'

node -e "var f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH||'';if(f.includes('/migrations/')&&f.endsWith('.sql'))console.log('\u26a0\ufe0f  New migration: add isolation tests in tests/isolation/ for any new tenant-scoped tables.');"
bash -c 'cd /Users/ab/P/TinyPhi/OpenWind; echo "--- Stop gate: typecheck + lint ---"; pnpm typecheck 2>&1 | tail -5; pnpm lint 2>&1 | tail -5'
